recorded_before: Any numerical prototype model fit or comparative result in this task
method: Joint depth-label GP with a proper uncertain global threshold and a centered input-dependent discrepancy
selection_reason: Both paid depth and canonical label inform one joint posterior. The construction addresses threshold uncertainty and systematic depth-label mismatch without assuming contradictory labels are unreliable. Direction B remains a principled extension if a usable auxiliary channel is demonstrated, but privileged-noise GPC alone does not model a future auxiliary observation or systematic morphology signal.
acquisition: Expected reduction of integrated posterior variance of the canonical-label probability, integrating the next paid depth and Bernoulli label under the coupled Gaussian posterior. Fixed uniform weights on the feature-only candidate pool; no q20 or held-out labels in acquisition.
inference: Exact Gaussian conditioning on paid continuous outputs; joint probit Laplace update on paid labels; retain cross-covariances. Fixed hyperparameters in the prototype.
identification: Fixed log-depth units and mean; depth coefficient fixed to one; no second intercept; discrepancy centered on the fixed candidate pool; proper Gaussian threshold prior; fixed positive probit scale.

prototype_defaults.note: Dimensionless controlled inputs only; these are not fitted SPH hyperparameters. A separate train-only integration policy is required.

planned_checks: Fixed known threshold and discrepancy-zero predictive identity, including the plug-in E1 hard-threshold limit
Uncertain threshold widens predictive uncertainty and labels couple depth and threshold
Depth-label mismatch can be represented by discrepancy; equal inputs cannot be arbitrarily separated
Sparse and zero paid negatives remain proper and finite; sensitivity to prior and model misspecification is exposed
No-auxiliary binary GP limit and paid-observation masking
Paired acquisition quadrature, variance bounds, epistemic-versus-irreducible ambiguity, and value of continuous versus label observations
comparison_policy: No method, sign, descriptor window or prior will be selected by the best comparative toy score. Numerical defects may be repaired with an explicit change log. Structural failures will be reported.
real_data_scope: No new real-data model fits or benchmark. OLD/NEW/POOLED and temporal GP benchmark remain with Opus. C3 is unused.
